decisions.description: One recorded routing decision per canonical work order, written by `forge.py route --apply`. `forge.py exec acquire` resolves the decision authorising a packet from this ledger, so a packet whose work order has no entry here is refused rather than acquired on trust. A later decision for the same work order replaces the earlier one.

decision.description: The forge.route-decision/v1 payload exactly as `route` emitted it, including lanes, leases, isolation_mode and tool_access.
